QuestInfo.name: [Springtime] Cornucopia of Color
QuestInfo.1: You learned about the Five Colored Pouch.
QuestInfo.2: You learned about the Five Colored Pouch. Time to do some hunting!

0.0: What do you know about the #i2431026# #bFive Colored Pouch#k? You know they only show after the #rSpring Rains#k, yeah?
0.1: Monsters usually carry #i2431026# #bFive Colored Pouches#k during Springtime. Just keep in mind that #bmonsters more than 11 levels lower or 21 levels higher than you#k won't drop them
0.2: Sometimes #bFive Colored Pouches#k will contain a #i3994635##bYut Stick Set#k. You can enjoy games of yut with the set. All you have to do is click on the #bGame of Yut notice at the top left#k.
0.3: The pouches also contain other goodies.\rOpen them up as soon as you get them!

no.0: Too bad. Let me know if you change your mind.

yes.0: You're such a good listener! Have this #i2431026##bFive Colored Pouch#k as a sign of my gratitude.
